summary: Introduce the provider-neutral CRM connector family and admit Bitrix24 through current universal CRM item and product-row APIs without changing frozen Connector or Runtime roots.

impacts.evidence: Bitrix24 account configuration and entity mappings remain organization/workspace scoped; remote IDs never select a TORGNEXA tenant.
V1 intentionally excludes contact phone/email multifields and activity/timeline payloads; OAuth access tokens remain callback-scoped secrets.
No public TORGNEXA REST operation changes; CRM SDK types are additive provider-neutral contracts.
No canonical event schema changes; Bitrix24 local event/webhook ingestion is deliberately deferred.
Frozen Connector and Runtime roots are unchanged; FamilyCRM and CRM reader/writer interfaces are additive SDK-v1 surfaces.
No database schema migration is required; existing mapping, sync, inbox and reconciliation persistence remains authoritative.
Portal host is HTTPS-bound and validated; OAuth token material is supplied only through SecretAccessor and Authorization Bearer, never URL/query/body.
Host approval/policy gates remain mandatory before CRM writes; provider capabilities do not bypass workflow governance.
Write receipts preserve stable remote IDs and duplicate/reconciliation outcomes for existing audit and lineage orchestration.
Entity creates reconcile on TORGNEXA originator/origin IDs; ambiguous entity and product-row writes read back desired state before reporting success.
V1 performs outbound calls only to the configured Bitrix24 portal host; inbound event/webhook support is deferred rather than weakly admitted.
Bitrix24 HTTP/API/rate-limit failures normalize through the existing Connector SDK error and health surfaces.
Admission is additive and can be disabled per account; no database rollback or Core branch removal is required.
Deterministic unit tests plus the Task-064 13-check provider conformance report are required and recorded.
